name: ProxCenter
description: Deploys ProxCenter, a multi-cluster management UI for Proxmox VE and Proxmox Backup Server. Community Edition runs the official Docker stack (Next.js frontend + PostgreSQL) on port 3000. Enterprise adds the Go orchestrator when an install token is provided.

notes.text: Requires Docker inside the LXC. Nesting and keyctl are enabled by default. The stack publishes port 3000 (HTTP + WebSocket); it does not use host networking.

Web UI: http://<container-ip>:3000. On first visit, create the admin account, then add Proxmox VE (port 8006) and optional PBS connections using API tokens. The LXC must be able to reach those APIs. Docs: https://docs.proxcenter.io/getting-started/connect-proxmox

The first-run setup endpoint is unauthenticated until an admin exists. Keep this LXC on a trusted LAN or behind a reverse proxy. If you terminate TLS in front of ProxCenter, enable the "Behind reverse proxy" toggle in connection settings and set NEXTAUTH_URL / APP_URL in /opt/proxcenter/.env to the public URL, then `docker compose up -d`.

Interactive install asks Community (default) or Enterprise. Unattended Community: `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oraad/proxmox-scripts/main/ct/proxcenter.sh)"`. Enterprise: `var_edition=enterprise var_install_token=YOUR_TOKEN bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oraad/proxmox-scripts/main/ct/proxcenter.sh)"`. Optional: `var_license_key=...`, `var_image_version=latest`, `var_nextauth_url=https://proxcenter.example.com`.

Config: /opt/proxcenter/.env (mode 600) and /opt/proxcenter/docker-compose.yml. Postgres and app data live in Docker volumes proxcenter_data and postgres_data (plus orchestrator_data for Enterprise). Do not change POSTGRES_PASSWORD after first start unless you also reset the postgres_data volume.

Update an existing container: run `update` inside the LXC, or `pct exec <CTID> -- update` from the Proxmox host. Interactive update shows Silent/Verbose/Cancel, then Update ProxCenter or Remove Unused Images. Unattended (`PHS_SILENT=1` or non-TTY) runs a silent app update. Dry-run via PVE LXC Apps Updater is skipped (Docker app).

Official defaults are 2 CPU / 4 GiB RAM / 10+ GiB disk. This script uses 2 / 4096 / 12. Increase RAM for large fleets or Enterprise (orchestrator + WeasyPrint). If Docker fails on an unprivileged LXC, try `var_unprivileged=0`.

Service logs: `cd /opt/proxcenter && docker compose logs -f`. Restart: `docker compose restart`. Health: `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health`. Enterprise license can also be activated in Settings → License.

Alpine template: run `pveam update`, then `pveam available --section system | grep alpine-3.23`. Download if missing: `pveam download local alpine-3.23-default_20260116_amd64.tar.xz` (use the exact name from `pveam available` on your arch). Fallback: `var_version=3.22` if 3.23 is not listed on an older Proxmox host.
Debian 13 and Alpine installs enable nesting and keyctl by default (Debian: systemd compatibility; Alpine: Docker).
